mission: M01 — Verifiable Neural Primitive Compiler: compiling finite-state temporal specifications into discrete integer integrate-and-fire networks. Repo root /Users/null3351/Code/neural-primitive-research/neural-primitive-compiler; all commits dated 2026-10-20, from 4d03b3e at 11:51 +0800 to 3c9a529 at 17:42 +0800.
question_as_posed: Repository framing (README.md:3): can executable, verifiable neural networks be built directly from capability specifications, without training weights per task? M01's narrowed question (README.md:52, README.md:19): for finite-state temporal specifications, can a network be compiled directly from the spec without training? The preregistration (research-hypotheses.md:9-17, H1-H8 at :21-87) splits this into: expressiveness equals finite-state (H1); an exact latency-1 realizability boundary (H2); dynamics buy succinctness but not computational power (H3); exact contracts do not remove state explosion (H4); synthesis scale limits, with LLM sketches helping (H5); non-preset topologies (H6); unseen tasks (H7); and an expected NOT-supported verdict on extension to broader intelligence (H8). The file was written after the toolchain and 112 tests were complete and after smoke results on 4 tasks had been seen (research-hypotheses.md:3). Phase 6 adds questions Q1-Q6 (evidence-ledger.md:171-208): is it only digital logic re-encoded, do dynamics matter, do contracts reduce complexity, can non-preset topologies be derived, what is provable, and does it extend to intelligence.
relation_to_origin: The sponsor's question (dated 2026-09-28 in mission-08/MISSION_08_BRIEF.md:14) concerns a discoverable, composable, transferable and verifiable generative law linking the STRUCTURE of BIOLOGICAL nervous systems to their CAPABILITIES. M01 replaced or narrowed every term. (a) "Biological nervous system" became an idealised discrete integer IF model with all delays >= 1 (theory.md:16-32), which is finite-state by construction (theory.md:41-48). limitations.md:7 says nothing is proven about any physical neuron. (b) "Capability" became a functional, past-time bounded-LTL formula written by the designer (limitations.md:15; tasks.npc:1-76). (c) "Discover a structure-to-capability law" became: compile the spec, decide realisability, and measure size and verification cost. The only structure-to-function laws produced are Theorem 3 (latency-1 monotonicity, theory.md:77-86) and Prop. 4.2 (an integrating neuron packs a mod-k counter, theory.md:95). Both concern the artificial substrate, and both are stated to be classical corollaries (prior-art.md:55,85). How each part was handled: VERIFY was addressed strongly, in the ideal semantics only. CONSTRUCT was addressed only as classical FSM compilation (Kleene/Minsky; README.md:28 "机制完全给定时，编译是经典问题"). COMPOSE was addressed as assume-guarantee verification: sound with feedback (Thm 5), with a negative result on complexity (H4). DISCOVER was not addressed: CEGIS is search inside a designer template, and Q4 says no derivation principle from spec to small network was found (evidence-ledger.md:189). TRANSFER was not addressed beyond unseen tasks drawn from the designer's own formula generator. The biological framing never appears in M01's documents.
biological_data_note: M01 used no biological neural data: no connectomes, recordings, developmental or perturbation data. The only "neural" content is the idealised integer IF semantics (theory.md:16-32; src/npc/network.py, simulator.py) and literature citations, all computer-science or neuromorphic (prior-art.md). Every input is a binary spike train, and all 2^m input letters are enumerated synthetically by the verifiers (verify.py:219-298). limitations.md:7-9 states explicitly that nothing is proven about Loihi, TrueNorth or any physical neuron, and that there is no rate, population or temporal coding.

claims.claim: Specs can be compiled into networks directly, with no training. All 31 tasks (10 in A-C, 21 in D) are either compiled by the classical construction or judged unrealisable by Theorem 3, and every compiled network passes unbounded verification.

claims.what_is_actually_established: For 27 compilable specs (10 A-C, 17 D), machine_from_spec + minimize + latency1_weights + the one-hot (state, letter) construction built networks that the explicit-state reach engine verified for all input lengths, in the ideal semantics. The networks have 6-258 neurons. The construction is Kleene/Minsky/Neftci 2013 adapted to delay >= 1 (prior-art.md:29,55,84), and the mission says so. Holding for all 31 tasks is guaranteed by construction, since the spec language is finite-state (theory.md:41-54). H1 is therefore a consistency check of the implementation, not an empirical finding. The theorems themselves were never machine-proved (theory.md:10).

claims.what_is_actually_established: Theorem 3 is a paper argument, a direct corollary of threshold-function monotonicity, and is not claimed as new (prior-art.md:85). The implemented decision only searches |W|, |alpha|, theta <= 64. Mission 02's audit later showed this is complete only for m <= 3 inputs, and gave a realisable 16-input counterexample that the tool calls 'no network of any size'. All unrealisability claims M01 actually published have m <= 2, so they stand. The H2 prediction was that CEGIS would return UNREALIZABLE at every size tried. That held only for D13 and D14; D05 and D12 timed out (CEGIS TIMEOUT at 120 s). The 'supported' verdict rests on the absence of contradiction (the falsification condition), not on the prediction being fully met.

claims.claim: Synthesised or known minimal networks are far smaller than the classical construction: CEGIS(IF)/classical ratios of 0.04-0.25 on A-C; on D, classical 6-258 neurons against known minimal 1-3; a gap of 4-100x.
claims.verdict_as_stated: H3(a) 支持
claims.what_is_actually_established: The ratios are reproduced exactly: 1/18, 1/14, 1/18, 1/18, 2/8, 2/10, 2/50. The baseline, however, is a deliberately naive one-hot construction with O(m*2^|inputs|) neurons, which prior-art.md:56 calls 远非最优 (Alon-Dewdney-Ott, Horne-Hush and Indyk give much smaller constructions). No optimal FSM-to-network construction or binary-encoded circuit baseline was run, so the '4-100x' figure measures the weakness of the baseline as much as any merit of synthesis. The 'known minimal 1-3' range is stale: after section 12, D02's smallest known network has 5 neurons, and README.md:68 itself cites that 5-neuron D02. All minimality claims are relative to the template.

claims.claim: Temporal dynamics give succinctness, not computational power. Integration packs a mod-k counter into one neuron, while window-type tasks need only synaptic delays.
claims.verdict_as_stated: H3 总体: 支持, 有修正. Q2: 在可计算函数类上没有.

claims.what_is_actually_established: On 5 Q2 tasks with the same template (|w| <= 3, potential [0,7], input delays {1,2,3}, recurrent delay 1, bias {0,1}, reset = init = 0): count2 and count3 need 1 IF neuron. A memoryless network needs 2 for count2 (n=1 UNSAT) and >= 3 for count3 (n=1, 2 UNSAT; n=3 TIMEOUT at 237.8 s). Window tasks need the same number either way. That the computation class is unchanged follows trivially from Theorem 1. The ledger itself flags count4 and window3of4 as template artifacts (E-Q2c). The lower bounds hold only inside the template.

claims.claim: Exact contracts do not remove state explosion. Explicit-state ratio is 1.0 for relay and about 0.5 for counter; the contract layer is 2-3x slower. Symbolic retest: finite-memory chains verify polynomially up to N = 64-256, while counter chains stop at N = 4.
claims.verdict_as_stated: H4 支持 (否定性结论). The broader inference 'unbounded verification necessarily explodes' was corrected in section 11.
claims.what_is_actually_established: The raw data reproduce the stated maxima: relay pdr_mono N=192 (108.8 s), window pdr_mono N=256 (61.0 s), counter explicit N=16, counter symbolic <= 4. Only 3 chain families of single-neuron primitives were tested, each point once, with one Z3 linear-integer encoding and default Spacer settings. The symbolic results come from a post-freeze tree (hash 29e40b3b...), not the frozen 8a163fab. The original sections 6 and 10 overstated 'unbounded verification explodes', and M01 corrected this itself. The remaining claim is that contracts change only constant factors. That is supported on these 3 families and by the paper Prop 6.2.

In the C3 cegis_if network, removing the leak on either neuron alone still verifies, so integration is not individually necessary there; the integration claim really holds for C1 and C2 n1. failure_pattern_instances.instance: The core result is the one-hot (state, letter) FSM construction (Kleene/Minsky/Neftci 2013), compiled into IF neurons. M01 says this outright: 'compilation is classical automata theory', and Q1 says the primitives are digital logic (latch = SR flip-flop, counter = saturating counter).

Finite-state formulas carry cognitive task names and docs: 'internal state / short-term memory' (B group), 'Novelty detector' (B3), 'latched alarm' (C3), 'remember_query'. The repository is framed as compiling from 能力规格. The names were never treated as evidence, but the framing persisted.

Symbolic specs and FSMs are compiled into spiking units, and the toolchain is called a 'neural compiler'. Q1 states that the neural layer adds only integer threshold gates and the packing of integration into one unit, and H6 is labelled constraint solving, not discovery.

failure_pattern_instances.pattern: Fitting inside a pre-set DSL or hypothesis grammar
failure_pattern_instances.instance: Task specs, primitive contracts and the unseen-task generator all use the designer's spec language. modcount and count were added specifically to express the counter contracts. The B1 spec 'y <-> prev(a & !r & modcount[3](a; r) == 0)' is exactly the counter(k=3) contract, yet the ledger reports that CEGIS '重新发现了 counter'. The 'rediscovery' only restates the spec. A2 likewise equals the window(2,3) contract and B2 the latch contract.

failure_pattern_instances.instance: All synthesis happens inside designer templates and grids, and specs are written by a human. The mission acknowledges this: the difficulty moves to writing the exact spec, and 'minimal' holds only relative to the template.

(a) The hypotheses were written after smoke results on 4 tasks were seen. (b) A DSL feature (choice holes over primitive type) was added while the C1 sketch was being written, before the freeze. (c) The author's A-C sketches were written after the author had seen the compose_dag dense-parity solution, and C2_llm1 reproduces it. (d) D02 rounds 2-3 were written after the failure. (e) H4 was retested with post-freeze engines. (f) H3(c)'s failure was explained after the fact. All were disclosed, and the original verdicts were kept.

By design the constructor receives the full spec, which is also the oracle, and CEGIS consumes counterexamples from the verifier. M01 therefore cannot test discovery; it is compilation with full access to the judge. Concrete leaks in the proposer arms: the A-C author had seen a search solution; the blind session saw the filename D02_cegis_n3_300s.json and shared a checkout with a session editing verify.py; the designer knew neuron attributes (init, vmin<0) that the blind user could not see.

Hand-written by the designer: 13 primitives and their contracts, the CEGIS template ranges, the compose parameter grid, the output-neuron readout, the formula generator, and the SKILL.md workflow. Mission 07's G0 later confirms that no M01 goal was system-generated.

For Mission 08, nothing in M01 bears on biological structure, its development or its function. The question of a structure-to-capability law was never posed against biological data.
why_original_question_still_unanswered: M01 never touched biological nervous systems. It used no connectome, recording, developmental or perturbation data, and its 'neural system' is an idealised integer IF automaton that is finite-state by construction (theory.md:41-48). Any law it finds is therefore a law of automata or threshold logic, such as Kleene/Minsky compilation or latency-1 monotonicity, not a law relating biological structure to capability. Each 'capability' was handed to the system as a complete formal spec written by the designer, in the designer's own language. Construction thus reduces to classical compilation, and the difficulty moves to writing the spec (evidence-ledger.md:202), on which M01 has no guarantee. Small structures were found only by template-bounded search (about 2-3 neurons) or by LLM decomposition of the spec, and the mission states that no derivation principle from function to compact structure was found (evidence-ledger.md:189). Composition was tested only for verification cost, with a negative result (H4). Transfer was tested only on unseen tasks from the designer's own generator. Discovery from evidence, generation of new circuits, and cross-domain transfer of a structure-to-capability law therefore all remain open.

mission: M02 – Mission 02 "Cognitive Primitive Discovery", first loop (branch mission-02; commits 57bee20 → b49a21a freeze, tree 1c40ea5a → bccacf5 → c5dbafe → b109e0e, all 2026-10-20). Files: /Users/null3351/Code/neural-primitive-research/neural-primitive-compiler/mission-02/, src/cog/
question_as_posed: The locked North Star (mission-02/RESEARCH_NORTH_STAR.md:7) asks whether there is a compact, parameterisable system of "cognitive computation primitives" with verifiable compositional semantics. With such a system a compiler or agent could read a never-seen cognitive-function specification and, only by instantiating and composing primitives and without retraining weights per task, directly build an executable neural or computational structure that is verifiable under stated assumptions. It splits into three questions that must not be swapped out (RESEARCH_NORTH_STAR.md:11-13): Discovery (where primitives come from, and whether they are more than renamed AND/OR, registers or FSMs), Construction (direct construction of unseen specs after the freeze, with no per-task weight solving) and Verification (deriving the whole function from local contracts). It also lists forbidden successes (:17): pure Boolean/FSM reproduction, huge one-hot nets, algorithms hidden in adapters/oracles/primitives, LLM-only justification, fixed dev tasks. Seven hypotheses were pre-registered (mission-02/hypotheses.md:12-20), including M2-H6, which expected the approach to equal program synthesis (:19), and a stop rule (:22). The question was instantiated on designer-written toy "cognitive micro-tasks": spatial working memory on an N×N bit grid, object–value binding, and objects-on-grid (mission-02/cognitive-domain-specs.md:5-25; src/cog/tasks.py:309-445). The substrate is Mission 01's discrete integer IF neurons (mission-02/G0-audit.md:40).
relation_to_origin: The original question asks for a discoverable, composable, transferable and verifiable generative law linking the structure of biological nervous systems to their capabilities, usable to construct systems with specified capabilities. M02 replaced it with a compiler question: can a designer-written mechanism-level spec of a toy task be compiled into a fixed-template IF network without weight search? Biology was dropped entirely: no biological structure, data or developmental process appears anywhere in mission-02/ or src/cog/. The term "structure" became the designer's IR and primitive templates (src/cog/ir.py, src/cog/prims.py), and "capability" became the designer's reference semantics (src/cog/tasks.py:1-16). Of the five verbs: (1) "discover" was tested only as black-box fitting of update rules inside the learner's disjunction hypothesis class (src/cog/learn.py:82-152) on designer tasks, and was judged NOT_SUPPORTED (SCIENTIFIC_VERDICT.md:13). (2) "compose" was addressed by the IR, timing algebra and the P4 theorem (compositional-semantics.md:9-27). (3) "verify" was addressed by Z3 proofs of abstract contracts plus differential testing (compositional-semantics.md:29-37). (4) "construct" was addressed by 16 post-freeze unseen tasks (SCIENTIFIC_VERDICT.md:21-41). (5) "transfer" shrank to size extrapolation (N=8, post-hoc 11) and a new task family (AB) drawn from the designer's own vocabulary closure (unseen.py:17 vs learn.py:214-221; N-UNSEEN-6, negative-results.md:25). The mission itself concluded that only a "neural implementation of program synthesis" was obtained (SCIENTIFIC_VERDICT.md:15, :146). It explicitly moved the next question to inducing mechanisms from goal-level specs (H-N1..H-N4, :150-157).
biological_data_note: No connectome, neural recording, developmental or other biological data is used or referenced anywhere in mission-02/ or src/cog/. A grep for connectome/biolog/elegans/drosophila/recording/neuroscience/生物/脑 returns no hits. The "neurons" are Mission 01's synchronous, noiseless integer integrate-and-fire units with all synaptic delays ≥ 1 (G0-audit.md:22, :40; README.md:13). Their weights are fixed functions of fan-in (src/cog/prims.py:3-5). All inputs are clean bit grids or one-hot channels produced by the designer's task generator (src/cog/tasks.py:214-236).

Both routes produce IR symbolically, and compile_ir turns it into fixed-weight IF templates; no route finds anything through neural dynamics. M2-H6 was judged true by a [P] argument.

why_original_question_still_unanswered: From M02's standpoint the biological half of the question was never touched. No connectome, recording or developmental data entered the work: "structure" was a designer-written IF-template library and "capability" a designer-written reference semantics of toy grid and binding tasks. The only "laws" obtained were classical: register-transfer datapaths, OR/AND reductions, pullback composition and additive timing, which the mission itself calls re-encoding. Construction worked because the mechanism-level specs already contained each command's coordinate map. A-LLM is reproducible by table lookup, and A-auto only identified parameters inside a designer schema with full-state readout, so nothing was discovered from evidence at the mechanism or concept level. Nothing was transferred beyond the designer's own vocabulary closure. Verification covers abstract contracts with limited letter counts and a fixed delay, not the compiled unseen networks: compile_ir is unproven and unbounded checks returned UNKNOWN. So M02 neither establishes a structure-to-capability generative law nor a principled way to construct specified capabilities from one.
open_questions_left: These hypotheses remain open; M02 proposed them and did not test them. H-N1: whether a typed index-space or equivariant substrate lowers the sample or search cost of inducing a mechanism from goal-level examples, compared with an information-matched untyped DSL. H-N2: set-valued contracts for generative modules. H-N3: whether the map vocabulary can be learned from passive observation by library learning and transfer across families (mission-02/SCIENTIFIC_VERDICT.md:150-157). Also open: an independent-session LLM route on example-only specs (M03 S1, BLOCKED); learning under hidden state without the img readout (M03 L3'); the name-suffix identity test (M03 L5); a semantics-preservation proof for compile_ir; SEL contract proof; P1 for arbitrary letter count and P4 for arbitrary D; and the provenance of the N-LEARN-1 numbers (A6, B4×3, N = 6, 2,921 probes), which may come from an uncommitted earlier run (unconfirmed). Whether a 4-neuron HP-1 template can realise the 2×2 LOAD+ROT90 task at all is not established either way.

The Mission 03 brief is not stored in the repository. It is only referred to as 任务书 (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:3, :27). The question is therefore reconstructed from the mission's own files. README.md:7 and :100 state it as: "不给机制，只给目标级证据（输入输出范例、被动观测），能否发现机制并构造未见能力？" It was operationalised in five phases (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:3).
(1) An unknownness/leakage audit of Mission 02 (UNKNOWNNESS_AUDIT.md:1-104).
(2) Competing hypotheses H-A (discover reusable mechanisms from examples), H-B (set-valued/generative goals), H-C (relational binding) and H-D (partial observability), with two nulls: H-0n, the neural backend is unnecessary, and H-0r, there is no representational advantage over an equal-information symbolic DSL (COMPETING_HYPOTHESES.md:7-8, 14-57).
(3) Pilot P1: "without enlarging the library, explain the two task classes Mission 02's A-auto could not solve" (conditional commands UA0/UA2/UA3/UA4 and the relational query `same` UB0/UB1) (COMPETING_HYPOTHESES.md:68; CHALLENGE_PROTOCOL.md:20-26). This was followed by concept invention, law signatures (P2), generative construction (P3) and prior closure (R6).
(4) An independent challenge on ARC-AGI-1 with M-DISC against the B-SAME/B-RICH DSL baselines (CHALLENGE_PROTOCOL.md:164-183).
(5) Phase-5 questions 2.1-2.7. One of them asks what necessary-but-insufficient knowledge was gained "与'天生具有绘画相关认知能力的结构'相比" (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:29-92, esp. :74).
The mission inherits Mission 02's north star: a compact, parametrisable cognitive-primitive system for directly constructing unseen capabilities without per-task weights (mission-02/RESEARCH_NORTH_STAR.md:7).
relation_to_origin:
The original question asks for a discoverable, composable, transferable and verifiable generative law linking the structure of biological nervous systems to their capabilities, so that neural systems can be built with specified capabilities. M03 replaces "biological structure" with designer-defined symbolic grid mechanisms: Mission 02's 12-move command pool (src/cog/unseen.py:17; src/cog/tasks.py:275-291) and ARC grid transforms. It replaces "law" with black-box mechanism identification / program synthesis inside hypothesis forms the designer supplies.
- DISCOVER is narrowed to identifying instances: which region, branch map, delay, library composition or ARC piece set, within given forms. The mission states that no new form was produced from evidence (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:37; OPEN_QUESTIONS.md:24).
- COMPOSE is touched only through guard+branch (CMR+ANY+GATE, Mission 02's P4) and the `same` composition from Mission 02 node types. There is no new composition proof (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:100).
- TRANSFER is tested as size extrapolation (N = 8, 11; third size for `same`) and as ARC held-out coverage (6/400).
- VERIFY is finite-sample differential testing plus ARC exact match. `compile_ir` remains UNPROVEN (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:101-102).
- CONSTRUCT a neural system is effectively set aside: H-0n is declared to hold, and networks appear only as a compile target in UA0 (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:21).
The only "principle" offered (the closure of discovered concepts under discovered dynamics) is said by the mission itself to be equivariant hypothesis classes plus Occam/PAC (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:50). The mission ends by redirecting the question to "where hypothesis forms come from" (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:85-92).
biological_data_note: None was used. No connectomes, recordings or developmental data appear anywhere in M03; a grep of mission-03 docs and code finds only the phrase "编译成神经元" at SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:92. Every DEV task comes from the session's own generator (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:12, :129). The only external data are ARC-AGI-1 public grid puzzles (mission-03/external/ARC_PROVENANCE.md:7-14). The only "neural" object is Mission 02's integer integrate-and-fire network, used as a compile target for UA0 through compile_ir (mission-03/experiments/p1_composition/run_amend34.py:58; README.md:13).

However:
(a) The designer chose the 6 held-out regions as D4 or shift images of the 2 training regions (run_closure.py:45-53). The 'discovered dynamics' are re-identifications of the designer's A_POOL moves inside the designer's piecewise-affine prior, and the closure is cut down to the designer's interval language (run_closure.py:150-167).
(b) L_mem and L_rand cannot contain the held-out regions by construction: 2 training regions, plus 6 random draws from 1,296 descriptions. Their 0/6 result, and therefore 'H-size refuted', is close to tautological.
(c) The informative contrast is a smaller hypothesis class containing the truth (85) needing fewer samples than a larger one (1,296), which is standard Occam/PAC, as the mission concedes. It rests on one seed and 6 tasks, and P8-2 failed at n = 10.
To call it the first case of prior content from data (SCIENTIFIC_STATUS.md:42) overstates it.

failure_pattern_instances.instance: The M03 audit confirms that Mission 02's CMR/SEL/ANY/GATE are re-encodings of register, selector, OR and gate. M03's own 'discovered' `same` mechanism ANY(AND(SEL0(qa,M),SEL0(qb,M))) is a Boolean/selector term from those nodes. M03 does not present it as a neural or cognitive novelty; it calls it program synthesis.

UA0 compiles a symbolic program, built from learned tables plus the hand-written W.spatial scaffold, into Mission 02's IF network through the unproven compile_ir, and checks it only by differential testing. M03 states that the network is only a compile target (H-0n). The ledger phrase 'all parts learned from passive data assembled into a complete network' was later carried into Mission 05 as the 'only B→A connection'.

failure_pattern_instances.pattern: Fitting inside a pre-set DSL / hypothesis grammar
failure_pattern_instances.instance: All results are fits inside designer forms: the union-map schema, a G-geo prior matched to the 12-move pool, 22 guards that include the true regions, the region-occupancy form plus 1,296 intervals, a `same` grammar of Mission 02 node types, and the M-DISC class. M03 states this repeatedly. The specific claim that R6 is 'the first case where the content of a prior came from data' is not caught: the closure operations are A_POOL moves re-identified inside the designer prior, and the held-out regions were designed as their images.

(a) Amendments 1, 3 and 4 changed the fit criterion and the region prior after failures on the same DEV tasks; disclosed, with a fresh-seed confirmation run (6/6) as mitigation. (b) The L2 box-domain extension was added after 23/25 and re-scored on the same 25 commands; it is framed as a discriminating C1/C2 experiment and not flagged as post-hoc. (c) Amendment 6 came after partially running confirmation task C0 and timing guards on its data, with the task parameters (true region 'left') known; disclosed. (d) README.md:104 says each modification was committed 'before the corresponding result', which glosses (a) and (c).

The P1 protocol bans the declared cond_delay value. Even so, the passive data generator _random_trace inserts a quiet window of exactly cond_delay steps after every conditional letter. The learner's delay identification ('stays, then one jump') relies on such uninterrupted windows. The learner never reads cond_delay, but the trace distribution encodes it, and the window is absent from P1's recorded privileges (full-state readout and random injection are recorded). K12 records the pacing assumption only for Mission 02. On ARC, solvers receive only test inputs: no leak in code. Possible pretraining knowledge of ARC by the LLM designer is acknowledged as unverifiable.

The method depends on: full-state readout from img, with the lag read from the interface declaration; arbitrary shape injection through LOAD; channel names and types (letters, qa/qb, K/KV) used to segment events and type the grammar; the REGION_IR adapter and the W.spatial wiring; and in ARC, background = 0 and whole-grid coordinates. Mission 04 later found that reference-frame changes break M-DISC (0/8), while background changes did not (7/7). M03 records the readout and injection privileges but not the adapter or wiring dependence in its headline claims.

failure_pattern_instances.pattern: Compute / expressivity mismatch between candidate and baselines
failure_pattern_instances.instance: On ARC, M-DISC tests 24 x 3,969 candidate pieces plus up to 4-piece covers per task, against about 11,155 programs for B-SAME. Mean times on evaluation are 0.564 s, 0.269 s and 0.486 s (B-RICH), the same order. The expressive classes differ: B-SAME lacks translations, and M-DISC cannot express 3x3 tiling; this is acknowledged in amendment 10.3. On DEV no baseline (EUSolver or Popper) was run at all, so the DEV half of H-0r is argued, not measured.

failure_pattern_instances.instance: Not observed. Every claim has a functional check: event-wise differential tests at unprobed sizes, or ARC exact match. The validation is finite-sample, and compile_ir is unproven.

ARC: dominance pruning, cap = 200, and the 256 limits in m_disc. Mission 04 found false uniqueness on 10 of 250 synthetic answers, 4 of them wrong, though none on the ARC-AGI-1 answers. P1/L2: branch_fit and L2 use l2_closure.candidates, which keeps only maximal pieces, so the 'unique' covers (covers: 1) in P1 and the confirmation run are lower bounds on ambiguity. M03 flagged the lower bound only for L2, and no later audit re-checked P1.

failure_pattern_instances.pattern: Protocol drift (implementation differs from the locked text)
failure_pattern_instances.instance: Amendment 9 locks M-DISC translations as 'anchored at 0, W, H, offsets −2…2'. The frozen code uses u, v in {0,1,2} and d in -3..3, giving 3,969 per matrix. Amendment 10 does not record this. The change was committed before any ARC result, so it is not result-driven, but it is undocumented. Also, commit d456f0f is described as 'before any ARC training-split result is seen' yet already contains 2 result lines of run_training.log; the solver files are unchanged up to the freeze (fa98aa8).

The confirmation and R6 held-out tasks come from the same session's generator (disclosed). In R6, L_mem and L_rand cannot contain the held-out regions by construction, so 'H-size refuted' adds almost nothing. The U-set's 20/20 abstention is fixed by its construction. Labelling uniqueness reliability SUPPORTED_EXT rests on a 1-wrong vs 4-wrong difference.

why_original_question_still_unanswered: M03 never examined biological nervous systems or any neural structure. Its 'structures' are symbolic programs in hypothesis languages the designer wrote, and networks appear only as a compile target through an unproven compiler. What it shows is that, once the designer supplies the form (union maps, region occupancy, piecewise-affine lattice geometry, Mission 02 node types), instances can be identified from passive full-state traces; the mission itself names this as program synthesis. No law linking structure to capability was proposed or tested. The single 'principle' is a DEV-level case of equivariant-class plus Occam sample complexity, on held-out concepts the designer built as images of the training concepts. mission: Mission 04 (neural-primitive-compiler/mission-04): audit of Mission 03's uniqueness evidence, and "representation invention / selection" on ARC grid tasks (block partitions, attribute families, part attributes, macro compression, background / colour-role / reference-frame priors), with two frozen confirmations (ARC-AGI-2 public evaluation set; twin tasks from an isolated session). question_as_posed: M04 set itself four tasks. (1) Is Mission 03's uniqueness evidence reliable? (AUDIT_M03_UNIQUENESS.md:1-13; STATUS.md:11,20-25.) (2) Can the system propose, from observation alone, an intermediate representation (objects, parts, relations, counts, hierarchy) that was not given as a construction rule, and does it give a measurable gain on tasks it has not seen? (REPRESENTATION_HYPOTHESES.md:7.) It splits "discovery" into three kinds: a new parameter, a new combination of known forms, and a transferable new representation form, plus a separate flag for rediscovering a known form (REPRESENTATION_HYPOTHESES.md:11-17). (3) Control of information, candidate spaces and priors (STATUS.md:43-61). (4) The most informative failures (STATUS.md:63-86). Sub-questions were added later: amendment 1 asks whether representation preferences can be learned across tasks (PROTOCOL.md:72); amendment 2 asks what conserved-but-unexplained tasks are missing (PROTOCOL.md:86-101); amendment 3 asks what structure is needed inside a block (PROTOCOL.md:103-117); amendment 5 asks whether background, colour roles and the grid frame can be decided by each task's own training pairs instead of fixed by the designer (PROTOCOL.md:126). The mission's own statement of the overarching aim: "研究初衷不变：寻找能让复杂认知能力按目标直接构造的基础原语与组合规律。ARC 成绩只作为测量工具" (STATUS.md:5). README.md:124 restates it as whether the representation layer can be proposed and selected by evidence rather than given by the designer.
relation_to_origin: Biological nervous systems are replaced entirely. M04 has no biological structure, no neural network, and no capability-to-structure law. Its object is symbolic representations of ARC colour grids: connected-component partitions, block attributes, colour normalisations. Of the five verbs: DISCOVER is the only one addressed directly, narrowed to selecting and re-deriving representations inside a designer-written grammar (blocks.py:15-21; PROTOCOL.md:22-31). COMPOSE was proposed (block representation x Mission 03 grid mappings, Y0-Y3, STATUS.md:88-105) but never run (README.md:146). TRANSFER was tested only as transfer of frozen symbolic solvers to ARC-AGI-2 and to twin tasks. It failed: 0/120 block-layer answers (CONFIRMATION_ARC2_RESULTS.md:31), and no candidate was admitted after the twins (CONFIRMATION_TWINS_RESULTS.md:51-54). VERIFY appears only as exact uniqueness of symbolic explanations within a hypothesis class, checked with Z3 and enumeration (AUDIT_M03_UNIQUENESS.md:51-61). It is not verification of a constructed system's capability. CONSTRUCT of a neural system with specified capabilities is absent. Mission 05 confirms that every M03/M04 ARC method is Python symbolic execution, none compiled to IR or a neural network (mission-05/G0_AUDIT.md:37, GAP-4 at :59). The "cognitive primitives" framing (STATUS.md:5) already departs from the biological structure-capability question, and M04 narrows it again, to representation selection for a puzzle benchmark.

mission: Mission 05 (A-first compositional cognitive constructibility; questions A and B in the designer-built 1-D transport domain LINE), audited for Mission 08 Gate 0
question_as_posed:
The mission posed two questions, from a user-provided brief "Mission_05_A_First_Compositional_Cognitive_Constructibility.md" (NORTH_STAR_A_B.md:3).
(A, main) Is there a set of basic primitives and composition laws that lets composite cognitive capacities (memory, object binding, relational judgement, conditional decision, goal solving) be built directly from a goal specification, systematically, efficiently and verifiably, with no task-specific weight training? And what advantages or limits does it have against a strong symbolic baseline with the same knowledge, time and search budget (NORTH_STAR_A_B.md:7; A05_SUMMARY.md:18-20)?
(B, auxiliary) If such laws exist, can they be discovered or revised from finite observations, at what knowledge cost, and when are they unidentifiable (NORTH_STAR_A_B.md:8)?
A and B were supposed to converge: B proposes laws, freezes them, and A tests them on unseen construction tasks (NORTH_STAR_A_B.md:9).
The domain chosen was T-R "LINE" (A05_PROTOCOL.md:17):
- Environment: N cells, coloured objects, hazard cells, an agent with a gripper (A05_PROTOCOL.md:19-38).
- Goals: conjunctions of ORDER/ZONE/GROUP atoms with NO_DROP_HAZARD/NO_PICK safety constraints and an optional cue (A05_PROTOCOL.md:40-53).
- Achievers: pick two cells; a fixed relocation macro swaps their contents (A05_SUMMARY.md:22-25).
The chain is goal spec -> controller IR (CIR) -> integer IF network -> closed loop with a reference environment, checked by three judges: J1-sym, J1-net and J2 (A05_SUMMARY.md:27-31).
- A was operationalised as A-H1 (pairwise-preservation contracts reduce construction cost versus the same-prior search A-SAME), against the null A-H0, plus A-H2, A-H3 and A-H4 (A05_HYPOTHESES.md:15-52).
- B was operationalised through amendments 2-6: B-1', B-EXCH, B-GRAM/B-R1 and B-RULE/B-SYM (A05_PROTOCOL.md:296-611).
- The original B-H1 (discovering preservation relations from traces with active queries; A05_HYPOTHESES.md:56-61) was replaced by B-1' (learning damage bounds; A05_PROTOCOL.md:296) and never run as written.
relation_to_origin:
M05 replaces almost every term of the origin question (a generative law between the structure and the capabilities of biological nervous systems that can be discovered, composed, transferred and verified, for principled construction).
- "Biological structure" became a symbolic primitive library the designer wrote by hand: six achiever variants (lib/model.py:16, 79-125) and a swap/relocation macro (lib/model.py:128-144). Nothing is derived from a nervous system.
- "Capability" became controllers that make conjunctions of ORDER/ZONE/GROUP atoms true in a toy 1-D world. The "cognitive" components are a latch register for the cue (memory and binding), detectors for relations, and priority control (cirgen.py:1-11).
- "Generative law" became priority composition with pairwise-preservation contracts plus a shared potential (Lyapunov/ranking) certificate. The mission itself says these are classical: serializable subgoals (Korf 1987), goal agenda, STRIPS interference, assume-guarantee, subsumption (A05_HYPOTHESES.md:5-13).
- "Compose" and "verify" are covered, but against hand-written Z3 encodings, the constructor's own macro model (N<=7) and judges written by the same session.
- "Discover" (B) was narrowed to recovering, inside designer-given hypothesis grammars, the increment law of designer-defined templates and the selection rules of designer- or session-written achievers.
- "Transfer" was planned as the cross-domain test T-G (A05_PROTOCOL.md:17; NORTH_STAR_A_B.md:14) and never run. In M05, the only "transfer" was to new achiever programs written in the designer's own ACH-DSL (G3/G4), with the same 98 DEV goals.
- "Construct neural systems" was reduced to compiling a symbolic finite-state controller into fixed-weight integer IF threshold neurons. The mission states the symbolic layer is sufficient and that it does not presuppose the network is necessary (A05_EXPLORATION.md:23; A05_HYPOTHESES.md:40).
- Biology, development and real neural structure-to-function mapping were left aside entirely.
biological_data_note:
M05 used no biological data of any kind: no connectomes, recordings or developmental data.
- The environment LINE, the goal grammar, the achievers and the templates are all designer-written (A05_KNOWLEDGE_LEDGER.md:7-19; A05_PROTOCOL.md:19-53).
- The "neural" substrate is the repository's own discrete integer IF neuron model from Mission 01. Its weights are fixed functions of fan-in and are never trained or searched (src/cog/prims.py:1-5, 44-67). It was used as a compile target, not fitted to any biological measurement.
- A grep of mission-05/*.md for biology terms returns no hits.

why_original_question_still_unanswered:
M05 never looked at a biological nervous system. The "structure" it composes is a symbolic achiever library the designer wrote by hand, and the "capabilities" are goal predicates in a designer-built 1-D toy world. So no mapping between biological structure and capability was observed, let alone a generative law.
The composition laws it confirms (priority composition with preservation contracts, and potential/ranking certificates) are classical planning and verification results, re-derived in a closed language. On the mission's own locked test they bring no efficiency advantage over a same-prior search (A-H0 holds).
"Discovery" (B) only re-identified designer-defined templates, and the selection rules of designer- or session-written programs, inside hypothesis grammars built to contain them. Whether such grammars could be found from data is explicitly left open.
"Neural construction" means compiling the resulting FSM into fixed-weight threshold units. "Verification" is relative to hand-written Z3/APP-R encodings and the constructor's own macro model at N<=7.
"Transfer" was not tested within M05 (T-G never ran). When M06 carried the law to ALFWorld, it exposed a hidden premise (applicability independent of other achievers' effects) that fails there.
open_questions_left:
These are the questions M05 leaves open, as stated by the mission (A05_SUMMARY.md:172-182) or exposed by the later audits.
- Where the hypothesis spaces come from: can B discover the potential grammar and the rule grammar itself?
- Applicability beyond N<=7: M06's APP-R later gave a hand-encoded [P].
- The residual A gap on ZONE window and relative-position rules.
- Coverage is 49/98. T2-style joint reasoning (A-H4) and layered potentials (A-H1'') are untested.
- Whether composition beats search on larger libraries or harder goals.
- External validity: one toy domain, one designer language, same-LLM-family generators, and no non-LLM held-out source.
Questions the audit adds:
- No end-to-end machine check of controller correctness for all N, since the Z3 encodings, APP-R and T-K are composed only informally.
- No check of the macro model against the environment beyond M06 G0-M1.
- Whether the 6 (G3) and 16 (G4) growth-rule disagreements are genuine.
- The cross-domain transfer test T-G and the original B-H1 were never run.
- No contact with any biological structure-to-function data.

question_as_posed: NORTH_STAR.md:5: can a small set of reusable, verifiable primitives and composition laws let a system build an executable closed-loop policy directly from a previously unseen goal-level specification, in third-party task environments, without large-scale retraining or per-task reasoning per capability? If not, where exactly does it break? The source is MISSION_06_BRIEF.md:5, and :13-17 states ultimate question A ("primitives and laws that can construct execution structures for perception, memory, binding, decisions, planning, error correction, generation"), method question B (can these be discovered from observation and active experiment rather than written by the designer) and the A<->B bridge. The question is split into four sub-questions (NORTH_STAR.md:11-14; BRIEF:32-44): F1 independent constructibility, F2 certification that does not borrow from the judge, F3 structure invention under unknowns, F4 a cross-domain constructive law. Six hypotheses go with them (HYPOTHESES.md:22-29, locked version :84-91): H-COMP, H-DISC, H-REPR, H-XFER, H0-CLASSIC, H0-SPEC. Gate 0 also re-audits the Mission 05 trust base (EXPERIMENT_PRE_REGISTRATION.md:35-43, questions Q-T, Q-A, Q-C, Q-K, Q-S, Q-M, Q-F). Non-goals (NORTH_STAR.md:16-21) explicitly exclude claiming success on self-made 1-D or 2-D worlds.
relation_to_origin:
The original question (2026-09-28) asks for a generative law linking the structure of biological nervous systems to their capabilities, one that can be discovered, composed, transferred and verified, and then used to construct neural systems with specified capabilities. Mission 06 kept only the verbs and dropped both the biology and, for every external result, the neural substrate.
(1) What plays "structure" is designer-written symbolic contracts, achiever macros and a 7-entry preservation table (experiments/g2/alf_core.py:62-70), not biological or even neural structure. "Capability" means task success on third-party benchmarks (ALFWorld text, with AppWorld only profiled).
(2) The neural part appears only in Gate 0. That gate audits the inherited Mission 02/05 compiler from CIR (the symbolic controller program) to integer IF networks, inside the designer's own LINE/ACH-DSL world (COMPILER_THEOREM.md; M05_TRUST_BOUNDARY.md:39 says it has "no implication for external environments"). Every external controller is plain Python and is never compiled into a network (README.md:13; no compile_cir or neuron code anywhere in experiments/g1..g4b, aw or b2).
(3) Mapping the verbs: construct = F1; verify = F2 (P/M/E/AX/U evidence map, VERDICT:52-66); discover = F3/H-DISC (selection among three designer-written hypotheses); compose = H-COMP plus G4b, the composition-depth test; transfer = F4/H-XFER, reduced to an expressivity lemma (X1) about the designer's goal language because no constructor ever ran in AppWorld.
(4) What it replaced: "a law from structure to capability" became "do primitives plus composition beat same-knowledge classical planning". The answer was no (H0-CLASSIC). The biological question is not addressed at all.
biological_data_note: No connectome, neural recordings or developmental data are used anywhere in Mission 06. A keyword grep of mission-06/*.md and experiments/ for biology, connectome, elegans, drosophila, flywire and allen found only false hits ("test_challenge" matching "allen"). The data sources are ALFWorld 0.4.2 (json_2.1.1_json.zip and json_2.1.3_tw-pddl.zip), AppWorld 0.1.3.post1 (data 0.2.0), the WorkArena interface metadata (no instances, BLOCKED), and the designer's own LINE/ACH-DSL specifications for Gate 0. "Neural" in Mission 06 refers only to the inherited compiler of integer IF neurons. Those neurons are memoryless (leak = vmax, reset = 0, all delays 1), so the network is a "unit-delay synchronous threshold circuit" (EXPERIMENT_PRE_REGISTRATION.md:31-33; COMPILER_THEOREM.md:47,55).

question_as_posed:
The brief's ultimate question (MISSION_07_BRIEF.md:196) asks whether constructed cognitive structure can create the capacity to originate new classes of goals, and whether pursuing those goals can recursively transform the structure again. It splits this into Q1 goal origin, Q2 goal/structure feedback with at least two loops, and Q3 a general transferable constructive law that beats equally informed baselines (MISSION_07_BRIEF.md:24-31), plus hypotheses H0-FIXED, H0-RENAME, H1-STATE, H2-COEVOLVE and H3-TRANSFER (:34-38).

The mission then narrowed this operationally:
- **S0 is defined as Markov in observation.** S0's predicates are functions of the current observation and needs only (AGENCY_DEFINITION.md:10). The goal language L(S) is conjunctions of at most k=3 literals with a time bound (AGENCY_DEFINITION.md:11; PROTOCOL.md:39).
- **"New goal class" is relative to S0.** It is defined against S0 via witness pairs, as a [P] claim (AGENCY_DEFINITION.md:45).
- **"New" excludes the meta-language M.** Novelty is explicitly not relative to M, which the designer supplies (AGENCY_DEFINITION.md:59; PROTOCOL.md:32-41).
- **Claim ladder L0-L4** (AGENCY_DEFINITION.md:76-84), locked criteria (PROTOCOL.md:100-112) and an outcome table (PROTOCOL.md:126-136).

Gate 0 conceded that the loop itself already exists in PowerPlay and IMGEP. It limited the possible contribution to (a) causal identification and (b) comparing organisational conditions (G0_AUDIT.md:78-84; HYPOTHESES.md:40-45).

Gate 0 also added the OC1-OC4 organisational-condition hypotheses and three fruit-fly functional hypotheses (HYPOTHESES.md:17-34).

The verdict answers re-worded questions rather than the brief's Q1-Q3:
- Q1: can a computational structure without agency develop an agent that forms its own goals.
- Q2: what organisational conditions agency needs.
- Q3: does structure help existing goals or change goal classes.

These are at AGENCY_VERDICT.md:18, 29 and 37. The README frames them the same way (README.md:11, 235). Their source is not in the repository; it is possibly the sponsor's chat prompt, and I could not verify it.
relation_to_origin:
The origin question is: does a discoverable, composable, transferable, verifiable generative law link biological neural structure to capability, so that neural systems with specified capabilities can be constructed? Mission 07 replaced it with a behavioural question about operational agency, asked in a designer-written microworld (ECO) plus Craftax-Classic.

- **Biological structure: set aside.** Biology enters only as three literature-derived "functional hypotheses" (PRIOR_ART_MAP.md:39-47). They are implemented as one-parameter knobs on the candidate: a goal-weight multiplier, a refit-window choice, and removing M3 (cand_fly.py:6-26). FlyWire is "reference only" (PRIOR_ART_MAP.md:47).
- **Neural systems: none.** Agents and judge are Python programs, not compiled to networks, and call no LLM (README.md:13). G0 states the IF compiler cannot express the needed dynamics (G0_AUDIT.md:68).
- **Discover: narrowed.** Discovery is likelihood-ratio parameter selection inside designer grids of M1-M6 (structures.py:30, 366, 473-494).
- **Compose: thin.** The only composition is the M2 form conditioned on a learned M1 predicate, and that form is itself designer-given (structures.py:8-10, 474-477).
- **Transfer: tested and failed.** H3 on two isolated-session families is 0/10 (G4_HELDOUT_RESULTS.md:95-111).
- **Verify: addressed only relative to S0** (witness pairs, judge-side grounding tests, preregistration).
- **Construct systems with specified capabilities: not addressed.** The mission inverted the direction toward endogenous goals instead of specified ones.

Net effect: the biological-structure → capability-law core of the origin question was left aside.
biological_data_note: No connectome, recording or developmental data was downloaded or used. The fruit-fly work (Krashes et al. 2009, Aso & Rubin 2016, Seelig & Jayaraman 2015, FlyWire 2024) was read from abstracts or publication pages only (PRIOR_ART_MAP.md:3, 43-47). It was turned into designer-written variants (cand_fly.py:6-97). FlyWire is explicitly "只作为结构参照；不要求复刻" (PRIOR_ART_MAP.md:47). G0_AUDIT.md:90 says fly neural organisation is used only as a source of functional hypotheses. mission-07/external/ contains only the held-out ECO families (heldout_families/), with no biological data.

failure_pattern_instances.instance:
The "new cognitive structures" M1 and M2 are finite-state trackers:
- M1 is a saturating per-instance counter with decay.
- M2 is a per-instance bit with a timeout (structures.py:66-180).

A "new goal class" means goals over the states of a learned finite-state tracker. S0 is defined as memoryless (AGENCY_DEFINITION.md:10), so the [P] witness-pair inexpressibility holds by construction (judge_eco.py:110-128).

The mission states that novelty is only relative to S0 (AGENCY_DEFINITION.md:59). It never says that the bottleneck is definitional, or that M1 fits the brief's own H0-RENAME wording of "extra state variables".

Not present. Mission 07 did not compile anything to IF/spiking units. G0 states the C_K compiler cannot express growing predicate sets (G0_AUDIT.md:68), and the README says agents are plain Python (README.md:13). A near-instance is biological relabelling: the fly variants are one-line knobs with neuroanatomical names (cand_fly.py:6-26). The mission credited them nothing and reported them as not supported.

failure_pattern_instances.instance:
M and alpha were written by the same session in the same commit (3c9fa05). M's grids contain alpha's exact parameters:
- theta=3 in {1..4}, D=25 in {10,25,50,100,inf}, delta=4.
- Context distance 2 in {1,2}.
- M2 context of "kind within 1 with learned counter >= 2", and T=150 in {50,150,300,inf}.

The positive results on alpha ("exactly the true parameters") are recovery of the designer's mechanism within the designer's grammar. On beta/gamma, which are mostly outside M, every arm scores 0/10.

The mission acknowledges M as the decisive prior and limits its conclusions to M. It does not state the exact grid-to-alpha correspondence.

failure_pattern_instances.instance:
Six candidate revisions were made after seeing alpha development results. Diagnosis used the designer's knowledge of alpha's true D=25 (G3_DEV_LOG.md:15-16,28).
- RECENT=3000 was chosen knowing alpha's phase length (cand.py:63; G3_DEV_LOG.md:36).
- A1.3 changed M1 semantics so that alpha's true structure would ground (PROTOCOL.md:152).
- A1.4 changed the M2 recipe; A3 changed the learner; A4 changed memory.

All of this happened before confirmation, was applied to every arm and is documented. Confirmation on alpha is therefore not independent of the tuning; beta and gamma are the real check, and they give 0/10.

Three deviations during the confirmation runs:
- Budget accounting switched from summed wall-clock to CPU time partway through (G4_NOTES.md:29). Under the original unit, Gate 4 would likely have exceeded the 45 h cap set in A5.
- The pre-registered rule "abort any run over 30 min" (COST_BUDGET.md:16) was waived (G4_NOTES.md:25). The promised itemised list of runs over 30 min is not in G4_HELDOUT_RESULTS.md.
- The Craftax TWIN_ARMS set and the scoring split were changed after the freeze, though before the affected runs (G4_NOTES.md:18-21).

The changes are disclosed, but the missing list and the effect of the unit change on the stop rule are not discussed.

At runtime there is no leakage:
- Judge and agent run in separate processes (run_eco.py:1-2).
- Agent modules import no judge code (agents/*.py imports).
- Fakes that inject true structures were caught by the provenance audit.

At development time a designer channel exists:
- The alpha-aware scripted teacher's lesson about vantage became candidate code (G3_DEV_LOG.md:35).
- Judge-side grounding scores on alpha development seeds steered the revisions.

The mission did not label this second channel as leakage.

failure_pattern_instances.instance: The headline positive, grounded s1 on 4/10 seeds, is a representational metric. Lives were 531 vs 531 for the twin. The mission reports explicitly that the structures changed the means to existing needs, not what the agent wants.

The only L2 pass sits at exact equality, 1.5 = 3 x 0.5, from 9 achieved goals versus 3 twin intervals. The s2 evidence fraction of 0.333 rests on 3 evidence steps. The s2 provenance audit passes with exactly 3 steps. The mission reported "恰好 3 倍" and treated it as a single seed.
The C2/C3 mapping rule (A2.4) gives C2 = C3 on both beta and gamma, so L3 there cannot be tested as predefined. The mission reported this and labelled its alternative POST-HOC.

- LIMITATIONS.md:29 says the learning arms did not learn the crafting chain (table, pickaxe). G4_HELDOUT_RESULTS.md:133-134 reports place-table rules on 8/10 keys and 225 vs 2 tables (I verified the counts).
- G4_HELDOUT_RESULTS.md:47 calls s2 "真实参数", but its T is 50 against alpha's 150.
- s2's exported q_struct was mutated to a counter created later (cand.py:486-488), so its grounding was evaluated on a composite.
- Holm correction (PROTOCOL.md:112) is never reported.

- The verdict answers re-worded Q1-Q3 (AGENCY_VERDICT.md:18,29,37), not the brief's Q1-Q3 (MISSION_07_BRIEF.md:24-31).
- H1 is declared "成立" although the candidate's pre-registered L1 test failed (p=0.055).
- H3-Craftax is presented as "holds at capability level" although HYPOTHESES.md:13 predicted at least L1 there, and L1 was 0/10.

The designer's brief to the isolated author asked it to avoid simple counters (BETA_AUTHOR_BRIEF.md:39-40). That pushes the held-out families outside M, which makes H3 failure close to guaranteed and turns the test into a test of M's coverage. It is consistent with the honest prediction at HYPOTHESES.md:13, but it is not discussed as a design choice.

why_original_question_still_unanswered: Mission 07 never touched biological neural structure: no connectome, recording or developmental data, and no neural system was constructed. The agent is symbolic Python, and the fly mechanisms became three parameter knobs that changed nothing measurable. Its one discovery mechanism, parameter selection inside a meta-language M written by the same session that wrote the development world, worked only where M's grids contained that world's exact parameters. It failed completely (0/10 grounded structures, every arm) on the two independently written families outside M. So nothing in it yields a structure → capability law that is discovered from evidence rather than supplied as a grammar. Even within M, the composition step (L3) occurred 0/10 times. The positive capability effect on Craftax was measured only against the agent's own no-learning twin, with no equal-knowledge baseline. The mission therefore leaves open the gap Mission 08 names: where the hypothesis space and generative rules come from. It does not test whether biological structure constrains or predicts capability at all.
